reason: Examined direct prerequisites def-invertible-sheaf, def-affine-open-subscheme and the relevant full-text The Stacks Project, Properties of Schemes, §§28.18, 28.27; Ravi Vakil, The Rising Sea, 29 August 2022, §§4.5, 7.4, 9.3, 10.6, 17.4, 17.6, 18.2 arguments. For U=Spec R let N=Γ(U,L), a rank-one projective R-module. The algebra Sym_R(N)/(s−1) has spectrum equal to the locus where s generates N: after every localization where s is a basis, the algebra is R localized; at a point where s vanishes, its fibre is zero. This proves affineness, and the intersection identity is a stalkwise nonvanishing test. The stated hypotheses, direction, empty cases and inherited AC are explicit; in-run suppliers remain draft for Step 3 verification.
